speech_priority.scope: Measured cue / amplitude-based priority envelopes; not word ASR or guaranteed perceptual intelligibility

sfx.stage: Actual mix contribution after narration duck / rhythm envelope / event sidechain / shared fade and limiter, before integrated loudness mastering

bgm.stage: Actual mix contribution after narration duck / rhythm envelope / event sidechain / shared fade and limiter, before integrated loudness mastering

narration.stage: Actual mix contribution after narration duck / rhythm envelope / event sidechain / shared fade and limiter, before integrated loudness mastering

sfx_onset_policy.scope: Renderer first-positive frame policy; encoded-pixel verification remains separate

stem_mastering_notice: Stem samples sum to mix_raw within float32 rounding; final mix applies measured integrated loudness normalization. SFX-only comparison can reuse identical muted video without any visual render.
